# reference type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceType`](gmeow-referenceType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of cadastral reference (parcel ID, folio number, title number, lot number, survey plan reference, etc.). Non-functional: a single reference may be classified by multiple sources as different types.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md) -> [`gmeow:CadastralReferenceType`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReferenceType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a cadastral reference by its kind (parcel ID, folio, title, lot, survey plan); non-functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the kind as a [`CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md) subclass.

### How to use

- Attach a [`gmeow:CadastralReferenceType`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReferenceType.md) individual; competing source classifications coexist.

### Examples

- ex:cr [`gmeow:referenceType`](gmeow-referenceType.md) [`gmeow:referenceTypeFolio`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceTypeFolio.md).
